name: Vitesse Energy (VTS)
teaser: Vitesse Energy paid $62.7 million of dividends in nine months against $21.8 million of operating cash flow after well spending. At $14.29 the shares sit 106% above my Base value of $6.94, so I call it Reduce.
llms: Vitesse Energy (VTS) owns non-operated oil and gas working interests, mostly in the Bakken. Valued on ten years of discounted free cash flow to the firm on a futures-based oil deck and an exit multiple on EBITDA. Bear $2.08, Base $6.94, Bull $15.42. Verdict: reduce at $14.29, maximum buy price $3.99. The 12.2% dividend is not covered by free cash flow at current futures prices.
